images.title: A rectangle and a slanted parallelogram with the same sides
images.purpose: Show the concept's own shapes: a rectangle with opposite sides 8 cm, 5 cm, 8 cm and 5 cm and 4 right angles, and a slanted parallelogram with the same sides and no right angle.
images.composition: Two shapes side by side with the same side lengths. The rectangle shows 4 right-angle marks; the slanted parallelogram shows matching arcs on its opposite corners and no right angle.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816, two shapes side by side, drawn to scale (54 px for every 1 cm). HEADING: the text Opposite sides: 8 cm, 5 cm, 8 cm, 5 cm centred at (728,100), bold dark #1F2937 sans-serif, 40 px. LEFT SHAPE, exactly 1 rectangle with corners (140,250), (572,250), (572,520) and (140,520) (432 px wide, 270 px high), filled teal #0072B2 with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px). Exactly 4 right-angle marks, one at each corner: a small square outline (white, 4 px, 26 px by 26 px) drawn inside the rectangle against the corner. Equal-sides ticks in reddish purple #CC79A7, 5 px thick, 32 px long, crossing the sides at their middles: exactly 1 tick on the top side, (356,234) to (356,266), exactly 1 tick on the bottom side, (356,504) to (356,536), and exactly 2 ticks side by side on each of the left and right sides, (124,379) to (156,379) and (124,391) to (156,391) and (556,379) to (588,379) and (556,391) to (588,391). Side labels in bold dark text, 34 px: 8 cm centred at (356,210) above the top side, 8 cm centred at (356,564) below the bottom side, 5 cm centred at (88,385) left of the left side and 5 cm centred at (624,385) right of the right side. Under the rectangle the text Rectangle (bold dark, 48 px, centred at (356,650)) and under it the text a parallelogram with 4 right angles (dark, 30 px, centred at (356,700)). RIGHT SHAPE, exactly 1 parallelogram with corners (740,466) (bottom left), (1172,466) (bottom right), (1334,250) (top right) and (902,250) (top left) (top and bottom sides 432 px, slanted sides 270 px), filled amber #E69F00 with the same outline. No right-angle marks. Equal angles are marked inside the shape with small white arcs (5 px thick): exactly 1 arc (radius 44 px) at each of the 2 narrow corners, bottom left and top right, and exactly 2 arcs one inside the other (radii 30 px and 44 px) at each of the 2 wide corners, bottom right and top left. Equal-sides ticks in reddish purple, 5 px thick, 32 px long: exactly 1 tick on each of the top and bottom sides, (1118,266) to (1118,234) and (956,450) to (956,482), and exactly 2 ticks side by side on each of the 2 slanted sides, (1244,344) to (1269,363) and (1237,353) to (1262,372) and (830,372) to (805,353) and (837,363) to (812,344). Side labels, bold dark 34 px: 8 cm centred at (1118,204) above the top side, 8 cm centred at (956,512) below the bottom side, 5 cm centred at (784,330) left of the left slanted side and 5 cm centred at (1290,386) right of the right slanted side. Under the parallelogram the text Parallelogram (bold dark, 48 px, centred at (1037,650)) and under it the text no right angle (dark, 30 px, centred at (1037,700)). No diagonal lines and no other marks. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: Opposite sides: 8 cm, 5 cm, 8 cm, 5 cm
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any number written on an angle, and any angle-measuring tool, anywhere in the frame
any shape drawn out of proportion to the stated side lengths
a right-angle mark on the slanted parallelogram
a rectangle with a corner that is not a right angle
more or fewer than 4 right-angle marks on the rectangle
images.takeaway: Opposite sides equal makes a parallelogram. With 4 right angles it is a rectangle; the slanted shape with the same sides has no right angle, so it is a parallelogram that is not a rectangle.
images.description: A rectangle and a slanted parallelogram, both with opposite sides 8 cm, 5 cm, 8 cm and 5 cm, one with 4 right angles and one with none.
images.context: Concept image for Parallelograms and Rectangles. It follows the idea of the figures in your maths book (a parallelogram, and a rectangle as a special parallelogram) and shows the concept's own example of opposite sides 8 cm, 5 cm, 8 cm and 5 cm.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the child what is the same and what is different about the two shapes. The slip to watch is saying a rectangle is not a parallelogram: the rectangle has everything a parallelogram has, and 4 right angles too.

image_decisions.why: The rectangle and the slanted shape with the same sides show that the sides alone do not make a rectangle, and that the right angles do.
